_comment: Texts of the HR policy screens (slice S1.23a), loaded with them (R-213). Urdu drafted with the glossary, to be reviewed by a native speaker (R-062).
pol.title: Policies
pol.description: The customer's rules as policies of each type, with versions in force from a date. Who gets which policy is decided by the assignments.
pol.empty.body: Create a policy of a type, then activate its first version and assign it.
pol.denied: You do not have permission to see the policies of this company.
pol.loadError: The policies could not be loaded.
pol.notFound: This policy does not exist or is not in your scope.
pol.col.name: Name
pol.create.title: New policy
pol.create.code.help: Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; it cannot change later.
pol.create.draft: The policy starts with these values as its first draft. Nothing applies until a version is activated and the policy is assigned.
pol.assignedCount: {count, plural, =0 {not assigned} one {used by # assignment} other {used by # assignments}}
pol.retired.note: This policy is retired. Its versions stay for the results that used them.
pol.draft.created: A new draft was created from the latest version.
pol.rename.title: Rename the policy
pol.retire.title: Retire the policy
pol.retire.body: From this date no version of the policy is in force. Assignments must stop using it first.
pol.versions.none: No version has been activated yet.
pol.draft.title: Draft version {n}
pol.draft.override: This draft changes a value of the country pack. The change is the customer's and survives pack updates.
pol.draft.saveFirst: Save the draft before activating it.
pol.draft.delete.title: Delete the draft
pol.draft.delete.body: The draft was never in force; deleting it changes nothing for anyone.
pol.activate.title: Activate version {n}
pol.activate.body: The version is in force from this date; the version before it ends the day before. A version in force is never edited, so results that used it keep it.
pol.activate.pending: The activation waits for approval by a second person.
pol.reason.help: Shown to the person who approves it, when an approval is needed.
pol.compare.same: The two versions have the same values.
pol.assign.title: Policy assignments
pol.assign.description: Who gets which policy: rules on employee details, tried in order. Activate a new set from a date to change them.
pol.assign.set.title: Assignments
pol.assign.one: Rules are tried from the top; the first that matches decides the policy.
pol.assign.many: Every rule that matches gives its policy (several policies may apply).
pol.assign.empty.body: Nobody gets a policy of this type. Add assignments to change that.
pol.assign.history.open: From {from}: {count, plural, one {# assignment} other {# assignments}}
pol.assign.history.closed: From {from} until {to}: {count, plural, one {# assignment} other {# assignments}}
pol.assign.editor.help: The whole set replaces the one in force from the date you choose. Conditions of one assignment must all hold; add another assignment for "or".
pol.assign.noPolicies: This type has no active policy with an activated version in this company yet.
pol.assign.from.help: After {date}, the start of the newest set.
pol.assign.from.first: The first set of this type.
pol.assign.pending: The assignments wait for approval by a second person.
pol.check.invalid: The set has problems; see the assignments marked.
pol.check.unmatched: {count, plural, one {# current employee would get no policy} other {# current employees would get no policy}}
pol.rule.fieldRetired: This custom field is retired: the set cannot be activated with it.
pol.rule.noChoices: Nothing to choose in this company.
pol.rule.typed.many: Type the values, separated by commas.
pol.rule.typed.date: Dates as year-month-day (2026-03-01), separated by commas.
pol.res.title: Which policy applies?
pol.res.description: Pick an employee, a policy type and a date to see the policy that applies and why.
pol.res.employee.help: Type part of the employee number.
pol.res.pick.body: The answer shows the rule that decided and every rule that did not, with the employee's own details.
pol.res.notFound: This employee does not exist or is not in your scope.
pol.res.because: Decided by the rule of order {order}
pol.res.reason.no_assignment_row: The employee has no job details on this date (not yet joined, or left).
pol.res.reason.no_rule_matched: No rule matches the employee's details. HR can add an assignment that covers them.
pol.res.reason.no_version_in_force: A rule matches, but its policy has no version in force on this date.
pol.res.attributes: The employee's details on this date
pol.res.rules.none: This type has no assignment on this date.
